dct_description_sm: Data was collected using the following instruments: Multi-Axis Differential Optical Absorption Spectroscopy (MAX-DOAS); Model 42 chemiluminescence NO–NO2–NOx analyzer; Aura satellite ozone monitoring instrument (OMI)

This is the dataset associated with the articles "Estimation of NOx and SO2 emissions from Sarnia, Ontario, using a mobile MAX-DOAS (Multi-AXis Differential Optical Absorption Spectroscopy) and a NOx analyzer"
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Estimation of NOx and SO2 emissions from Sarnia, Ontario, using a mobile MAX-DOAS (Multi-AXis Differential Optical Absorption Spectroscopy) and a NOx analyzer
